what.fr: L'agent est optimisé avec PPO à estimation d'avantage au niveau de chaque étape, avec un LLM-juge fournissant des récompenses denses par étape et une récompense terminale.
what.en: The agent is optimized with PPO using step-level advantage estimation, with an LLM-as-a-Judge providing dense step-level rewards plus a terminal reward.

rejected.detail: The quote only mentions PPO with step-level advantage estimation; the LLM-as-a-Judge dense and terminal rewards are not in the quote.

what.fr: Selon la DIA, la Chine a plus que triplé ses lancements spatiaux annuels en dix ans : 22 en 2016 et 93 en 2025.
what.en: The DIA writes that China has more than tripled its space launches per year in the past decade, with 22 launches in 2016 and 93 in 2025.

rejected.detail: The quote does not attribute the claim to the DIA; the attribution is not established by the quote alone.

what.fr: Un cadre RL en ligne pour la navigation d'interfaces sur de vraies applications iOS
what.en: An online RL framework for UI navigation on live iOS apps

rejected.detail: The closing recommendation introduces unsupported facts: that the 8B model gets 'close to' proprietary models (it outperformed one and tied another) and that this comes at the cost of substantial emulation infrastructure.

what.fr: Realtime-Bench : l'écart entre horloge réelle et horloge en pause
what.en: Realtime-Bench: the gap between wall clock and paused clock

rejected.detail: The closing claim that thinking time can weigh on success as much as raw capability is a causal inference not found in the cited facts, which only report scores under the two settings.
The statement that restricted access limits independent evaluation by teams is a new claim not contained in the cited facts.
